title: SG-5.4.2 BootScene preloads only planned assets with fallback texture
summary: BootScene preloads planPreload assets, resolves keys via resolveTextureKey and falls back for missing assets
description: Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey exist in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts but BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no preload and effectContext.ts passes spec.asset straight to Phaser. Desired behavior: BootScene loads only the planned assets, resolves every texture key through resolveTextureKey and uses a fallback texture for missing or invalid assets. Why: avoid loading unused assets and avoid crashes or green-box textures.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bedroom scene, when BootScene.preload runs, then only ids in planPreload(scene, manifest).load are queued with the loader
Given an id not in the manifest or a file that fails to load, when a texture key is resolved, then the fallback texture key is returned and used
Given the dust effect asset, when the effect is created, then its texture key comes from resolveTextureKey
technical_constraints: Engine code in game/src must not import Phaser
definition_of_done: Both requirements verified by unit tests
